customers_say: Customers find the door lock worth its price and appreciate its straightforward installation process, with one customer noting the clear setup instructions. Moreover, the device provides all necessary features, is easy to use, and offers good security with an anti-pry/tamper alarm. Additionally, they like its appearance and functionality, with one customer highlighting the useful camera feature. However, the battery life receives negative feedback, with customers reporting very short battery duration of 30-45 days.
